offensiveAbilities.description: If your next action is to Cast a Spell that has an area of a burst, cone, or line, and does not have a duration; Add 5 feet to the radius of a burst that normally has a radius of at least 10 feet (a burst with a smaller radius is not affected). Add 5 feet to the length of a cone or line that is normally 15 feet long or smaller, and add 10 feet to the length of a larger cone or line.

damageRolls.roll: 1 acid plus 4d6 persistent acid damage and 4 splash damage
4d8 fire damage plus 4 persistent fire damage plus 4 splash damage

offensiveAbilities.name: Quick Alchemy
offensiveAbilities.description:
Cost 1 batch of infused reagents
RequirementsYou have the formula for the alchemical item you're creating, and you're either holding or wearing alchemist's tools.
EffectYou swiftly mix up a short-lived alchemical item to use at a moment's notice. You create a single alchemical consumable item of your advanced alchemy level or lower that's in your formula book without having to spend the normal monetary cost in alchemical reagents or needing to attempt a Crafting check. This item has the infused trait, but it remains potent only until the start of your next turn.

offensiveAbilities.name: Quick Bomber
offensiveAbilities.description: You keep your bombs in easy-to-reach pouches from which you draw without thinking. You Interact to draw a bomb, then Strike with it.

offensiveAbilities.name: Quick Alchemy
offensiveAbilities.description:
Cost 1 batch of infused reagents
Requirements You have the formula for the alchemical item you're creating, and you're either holding or wearing alchemist's tools.
You swiftly mix up a short-lived alchemical item to use at a moment's notice. You create a single alchemical consumable item of your advanced alchemy level or lower that's in your formula book without having to spend the normal monetary cost in alchemical reagents or needing to attempt a Crafting check. This item has the infused trait, but it remains potent only until the start of your next turn.

offensiveAbilities.name: Sticky Bomb
offensiveAbilities.description:
FrequencyOnce per round
TriggerYou use Quick Alchemy to craft an alchemical bomb that is at least 2 levels lower than your advanced alchemy level.
EffectYou mix in an additive to make your bomb’s contents adhere to the target and continue to deal damage. A creature that takes a direct hit from one of your sticky bombs also takes persistent damage equal to and of the same type as the bomb’s splash damage. If the bomb already deals persistent damage, combine the two amounts.

offensiveAbilities.name: True Debilitating Bomb
offensiveAbilities.description:
FrequencyOnce per round
TriggerYou use Quick Alchemy to craft an alchemical bomb that is at least 2 levels lower than your advanced alchemy level.
EffectYour bombs impose additional effects on your enemies. You mix a substance into the bomb that causes one of the following: dazzled, deafened, flat-footed, clumsy 1, enfeebled 2, stupefied 2, or a –15-foot status penalty to Speeds. If the attack with that bomb hits, the target must succeed at a Fortitude saving throw or suffer that effect until the start of your next turn. Use your class DC for this saving throw (even if someone else throws the bomb).

offensiveAbilities.name: Miracle Worker
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency Once every 10 minutes
EffectYour alchemical mastery can resuscitate the recently slain. You can administer a true elixir of life to a creature who has been dead for no more than 2 rounds. When you do, that creature is immediately returned to life with 1 Hit Point and becomes wounded 1.

generalAbilities.name: Raging Intimidation
generalAbilities.description: The barbarian can Demoralize while Raging

defensiveAbilities.name: Shake it off
defensiveAbilities.description: You concentrate on your rage, overcoming fear and fighting back sickness. Reduce your frightened condition value by 1, and attempt a Fortitude save to recover from the sickened condition as if you had spent an action retching; you reduce your sickened condition value by 1 on a failure (but not on a critical failure), by 2 on a success, or by 3 on a critical success.

defensiveAbilities.name: Attack of Opportunity
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature within your reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it’s using.

You lash out at a foe that leaves an opening. Make a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If your attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, you disrupt that action. This Strike doesn’t count toward your multiple attack penalty, and your multiple attack penalty doesn’t apply to this Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Rage
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements You aren’t fatigued or raging.

You tap into your inner fury and begin raging. You gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to your level plus your Constitution modifier. This frenzy lasts for 1 minute, until there are no enemies you can perceive, or until you fall unconscious, whichever comes first. You can't voluntarily stop raging. While you are raging:

  • You deal 12 additional damage with melee Strikes. This additional damage is halved if your weapon or unarmed attack is agile.
  • You take a –1 penalty to AC.
  • You can't use actions with the concentrate trait unless they also have the rage trait. You can Seek while raging.

    • After you stop raging, you lose any remaining temporary Hit Points from Rage, and you can't Rage again for 1 minute.

offensiveAbilities.name: Fast Movement
offensiveAbilities.description: Your rage is a frenzy of rapid movements. While you are raging, you gain a +10-foot status bonus to your Speed

offensiveAbilities.name: Knockback
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements Your last action was a successful Strike.

The weight of your swing drives your enemy back. You push the foe back 5 feet, with the effects of a successful Shove. You can follow the foe as normal for a successful Shove.

offensiveAbilities.name: Whirlwind Strike
offensiveAbilities.description: You attack all nearby adversaries. Make a melee Strike against each enemy within your melee reach. Each attack counts toward your multiple attack penalty, but do not increase your penalty until you have made all your attacks.

offensiveAbilities.name: Viscious Evisceration
offensiveAbilities.description: You make a vicious attack that maims your enemy. Make a melee Strike. If the Strike hits and deals damage, the target is drained 1, or drained 2 on a critical success.

offensiveAbilities.name: Quickened Casting
offensiveAbilities.description: If your next action is to cast a cantrip or a spell that is at least 2 levels lower than the highest level spell slot you have, reduce the number of actions to cast it by 1 (minimum 1 action).

offensiveAbilities.name: Reach Spell
offensiveAbilities.description: If your next action is to Cast a Spell that has a range, increase that spell's range by 30ft

offensiveAbilities.name: Effortless Concentration
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger Your turn begins
Effect you Sustain a Spell

offensiveAbilities.name: Eternal Composition
offensiveAbilities.description: You are permanently quickened, and can use the extra action only to cast composition cantrips that require 1 action to cast.

generalAbilities.name: Celestial/Fiendish Form
generalAbilities.description: The champion gains a fly speed equal to their speed, as well as darkvision, and the celestial/fiend trait.

defensiveAbilities.name: Retributive Strike
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger An enemy damages your ally, and both are within 15 feet of you.
Effect
  • The ally gains resistance to all damage against the triggering damage equal to 2 + your level.
  • If the foe is within reach, make a melee Strike against it.
  • Each ally within 15 feet of you with the target in their melee reach can spend a reaction to Strike the target with a –5 penalty.
  • The triggering creature takes 5 persistent good or evil damage.

defensiveAbilities.name: Ranged Reprisal
defensiveAbilities.description: The champion can use Retributive Strike with a ranged weapon. If the triggering creature is within 5 feet of the champion's reach, the champion may Step as part of their reaction in order to reach them.

defensiveAbilities.name: Raise Shield
defensiveAbilities.description: The champion gains a +2 circumstance bonus to their AC until the start of their next turn.

You lash out at a foe that leaves an opening. Make a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If your attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, you disrupt that action. This Strike doesn’t count toward your multiple attack penalty, and your multiple attack penalty doesn’t apply to this Strike.

defensiveAbilities.name: Aura of Faith
defensiveAbilities.description: Your strikes deal 1 additional good/evil damage, and each good/evil aligned ally within 15 feet gains this benefit on their first Strike that hits and evil creature each round. (swap this for evil if this champion is evil)

defensiveAbilities.name: Divine Reflexes
defensiveAbilities.description: The champion gains an additional reaction per turn that they can only use for a Retributive Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Greater Mercy
offensiveAbilities.description: If the next action you use is to cast lay on hands, you can attempt to counteract either a fear effect, an effect imposing the paralyzed, blinded, deafened, sickened, or slowed condition, on the target, in addition to the other benefits of lay on hands.

offensiveAbilities.name: Healing/Harming Hands
offensiveAbilities.description: Your Heals/Harms deal d10s instead of d8s

offensiveAbilities.name: Channel Smite
offensiveAbilities.description:
Cost Expend a harm or heal spell
EffectYou siphon the destructive energies of positive or negative energy through a melee attack and into your foe. Make a melee Strike and add the spell’s damage to the Strike’s damage. This is negative damage if you expended a harm spell or positive damage if you expended a heal spell. The spell is expended with no effect if your Strike fails or hits a creature that isn’t damaged by that energy type (such as if you hit a non-undead creature with a heal spell).

offensiveAbilities.name: Selective Energy
offensiveAbilities.description: As you call down divine power, you can prevent some enemies from benefiting or some allies from being hurt. When you cast a version of harm or heal that has an area, you can designate a number of creatures equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1) that are not targeted by the spell.

offensiveAbilities.name: Wolf Stance
offensiveAbilities.description: The monk enters wolf stance, allowing them to use the wolf jaw strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Crushing Grab
offensiveAbilities.description: When the monk successfully Grapples a creature, they can deal 4 bludgeoning damage to that creature.

offensiveAbilities.name: Wolf Drag
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements You are in Wolf Stance.
You rip your enemy off their feet. Make a wolf jaw Strike. Your wolf jaw gains the fatal d12 trait for this Strike, and if the attack succeeds, you knock the target prone.

offensiveAbilities.name: Wall Run
offensiveAbilities.description: The monk Strides up to their Speed. They must start your movement on a horizontal surface. During this movement, they can run up vertical surfaces, like walls, at their full Speed. If they end the Stride off the ground, they fall after taking their next action or when your turn ends, whichever comes first (though you can Grab an Edge, if applicable).

offensiveAbilities.name: Winding Flow
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per round
You use two of the following actions in any order: Stand, Step, and Stride. You can’t use the same action twice.

offensiveAbilities.name: Shattering Strike
offensiveAbilities.description: The force of your considered blow shatters objects and defenses alike. Make an unarmed Strike. It bypasses the target’s resistances. If the target has Hardness, the Strike treats the Hardness as if it were half its value.

offensiveAbilities.name: Enduring Quickness
offensiveAbilities.description: You move as fast and as high as the wind itself. You’re permanently quickened. You can use your extra action to Stride or Leap, or to provide one of the actions needed for a High Jump or Long Jump.

offensiveAbilities.name: Hunt Prey
offensiveAbilities.description: Designate a target as prey, you gain a +4 circumstance bonus Seek and Track them, and ignore penalty for making ranged attacks within your second and third range increment against the prey you’re hunting. You can only have 1 creature marked as prey.<hr>You can use this as a free action if it's the first action on your turn.

offensiveAbilities.name: Precision Edge
offensiveAbilities.description: The first time they hit their Prey this turn, the Ranger deals an extra 3d8 precision damage to them; 2d8 precision damage the second time; and 1d8 precision damage the third time.

offensiveAbilities.name: Nature's Edge
offensiveAbilities.description: Enemies in naturally occuring difficult terrain are flat-footed to the Ranger.

offensiveAbilities.name: Quickdraw
offensiveAbilities.description: The Ranger draws a weapon and makes a Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Skirmish Strike
offensiveAbilities.description: The Ranger Steps and then Strikes, or Strikes and then Steps

offensiveAbilities.name: Blind Fight
offensiveAbilities.description: The Ranger does not need to make flat checks to hit concealed creatures, and the flat check to hit hidden creatures is only DC 5. They are not Flat-Footed to Hidden creatures because of their Hidden status.

offensiveAbilities.name: Camouflage
offensiveAbilities.description: The Ranger can Sneak in natural terrain, even if Observed.

offensiveAbilities.name: Shadow Hunter
offensiveAbilities.description: In natural terrain, he Ranger is always concealed, except to its Prey.

offensiveAbilities.name: Ultimate Skirmisher
offensiveAbilities.description: The ranger does not trigger Hazards, and ignores Difficult Terrain, Greater Difficult Terrain, and Hazardous Terrain.

generalAbilities.name: Sneak Savant
generalAbilities.description: If the rogue fails a Stealth check, they gets a success instead. They can still critically fail.

defensiveAbilities.name: Nimble Dodge
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The rogue is targeted with an attack, and can see the attacker.
EffectThe rogue gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the attack.

defensiveAbilities.name: Mobility
defensiveAbilities.description: If the rogue strides half their movement, it does not trigger reactions.

offensiveAbilities.name: Sneak Attack
offensiveAbilities.description: The Rogue deals an extra 6d6 precision damage to flat-footed creatures.

offensiveAbilities.name: Surprise attack
offensiveAbilities.description: Creatures that haven't taken a turn yet are flat-footed to the rogue

offensiveAbilities.name: Gang Up
offensiveAbilities.description: Enemies within reach of allies count as flat-footed to the rogue, regardless of the ally's position.

offensiveAbilities.name: Opportune Backstab
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature within the rogue's melee reach is hit by a melee attack from one of its allies.
Effect The rogue makes a strike against the creature.

offensiveAbilities.name: Spring from the Shadows
offensiveAbilities.description: The rogue strides up to a creature it is hidden or undetected by, and strikes. The rogue stays hidden or undetected until after the strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Dangerous Sorcery
offensiveAbilities.description: When you cast a spell from your spell slots, if the spell deals damage and doesn't have a duration, you gain a status bonus equal to the spell's level.

offensiveAbilities.name: Quickened Casting
offensiveAbilities.description: If your next action is to cast a cantrip or a spell that is at least 2 levels lower than the highest level spell slot you have, reduce the number of actions to cast it by 1 (minimum 1 action).

offensiveAbilities.name: Effortless Concentration
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger Your turn begins
Effect you Sustain a Spell

offensiveAbilities.name: Reach Spell
offensiveAbilities.description: If your next action is to Cast a Spell that has a range, increase that spell's range by 30ft

offensiveAbilities.name: Widen Spell
offensiveAbilities.description: If your next action is to Cast a Spell that has an area of a burst, cone, or line, and does not have a duration; Add 5 feet to the radius of a burst that normally has a radius of at least 10 feet (a burst with a smaller radius is not affected). Add 5 feet to the length of a cone or line that is normally 15 feet long or smaller, and add 10 feet to the length of a larger cone or line.

defensiveAbilities.name: Counterspell
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature Casts a Spell that the Wizard has prepared.
Effect Expend a spells slot of the same spell. Then counteract the same spell. You lose the spell slot if it was not the same spell.

offensiveAbilities.name: Drain Bonded Item (Universalist)
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency Once per day per spell level
Effect Mark one spell that's already been cast as uncast. The wizard can cast it again. The wizard can do this for each level of spell slots they have.

offensiveAbilities.name: Reflect Spell
offensiveAbilities.description: When you succesfully use Counterspell to counteract a spell that affects targeted creatures or an area, you reflect it back on its caster. The spell now only affects the original caster, even if it was an area spell, or one that would affect multiple creatures. The original caster can attempt saves and use other defenses against the spell as normal.

4d8 fire damage plus 4 persistent fire damage plus 4 splash damage

offensiveAbilities.name: Quick Alchemy
offensiveAbilities.description:
Cost 1 batch of infused reagents
RequirementsYou have the formula for the alchemical item you're creating, and you're either holding or wearing alchemist's tools.
EffectYou swiftly mix up a short-lived alchemical item to use at a moment's notice. You create a single alchemical consumable item of your advanced alchemy level or lower that's in your formula book without having to spend the normal monetary cost in alchemical reagents or needing to attempt a Crafting check. This item has the infused trait, but it remains potent only until the start of your next turn.

offensiveAbilities.name: Quick Bomber
offensiveAbilities.description: You keep your bombs in easy-to-reach pouches from which you draw without thinking. You Interact to draw a bomb, then Strike with it.

offensiveAbilities.name: Quick Alchemy

This item has the infused trait, but it remains potent only until the start of your next turn.

offensiveAbilities.name: Sticky Bomb
offensiveAbilities.description:
FrequencyOnce per round
TriggerYou use Quick Alchemy to craft an alchemical bomb that is at least 2 levels lower than your advanced alchemy level.
EffectYou mix in an additive to make your bomb’s contents adhere to the target and continue to deal damage. A creature that takes a direct hit from one of your sticky bombs also takes persistent damage equal to and of the same type as the bomb’s splash damage. If the bomb already deals persistent damage, combine the two amounts.

offensiveAbilities.name: True Debilitating Bomb
offensiveAbilities.description:
FrequencyOnce per round
TriggerYou use Quick Alchemy to craft an alchemical bomb that is at least 2 levels lower than your advanced alchemy level.
EffectYour bombs impose additional effects on your enemies. You mix a substance into the bomb that causes one of the following: dazzled, deafened, flat-footed, clumsy 1, enfeebled 2, stupefied 2, or a –15-foot status penalty to Speeds. If the attack with that bomb hits, the target must succeed at a Fortitude saving throw or suffer that effect until the start of your next turn. Use your class DC for this saving throw (even if someone else throws the bomb).

offensiveAbilities.name: Miracle Worker
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency Once every 10 minutes
EffectYour alchemical mastery can resuscitate the recently slain. You can administer a true elixir of life to a creature who has been dead for no more than 2 rounds. When you do, that creature is immediately returned to life with 1 Hit Point and becomes wounded 1.

generalAbilities.name: Raging Intimidation
generalAbilities.description: The barbarian can Demoralize while Raging

defensiveAbilities.name: Shake it off
defensiveAbilities.description: You concentrate on your rage, overcoming fear and fighting back sickness. Reduce your frightened condition value by 1, and attempt a Fortitude save to recover from the sickened condition as if you had spent an action retching; you reduce your sickened condition value by 1 on a failure (but not on a critical failure), by 2 on a success, or by 3 on a critical success.

defensiveAbilities.name: Attack of Opportunity
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature within your reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it’s using.

You lash out at a foe that leaves an opening. Make a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If your attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, you disrupt that action. This Strike doesn’t count toward your multiple attack penalty, and your multiple attack penalty doesn’t apply to this Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Rage
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements You aren’t fatigued or raging.

You tap into your inner fury and begin raging. You gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to your level plus your Constitution modifier. This frenzy lasts for 1 minute, until there are no enemies you can perceive, or until you fall unconscious, whichever comes first. You can't voluntarily stop raging. While you are raging:

  • You deal 12 additional damage with melee Strikes. This additional damage is halved if your weapon or unarmed attack is agile.
  • You take a –1 penalty to AC.
  • You can't use actions with the concentrate trait unless they also have the rage trait. You can Seek while raging.

    • After you stop raging, you lose any remaining temporary Hit Points from Rage, and you can't Rage again for 1 minute.

offensiveAbilities.name: Fast Movement
offensiveAbilities.description: Your rage is a frenzy of rapid movements. While you are raging, you gain a +10-foot status bonus to your Speed

offensiveAbilities.name: Knockback
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements Your last action was a successful Strike.

The weight of your swing drives your enemy back. You push the foe back 5 feet, with the effects of a successful Shove. You can follow the foe as normal for a successful Shove.

offensiveAbilities.name: Whirlwind Strike
offensiveAbilities.description: You attack all nearby adversaries. Make a melee Strike against each enemy within your melee reach. Each attack counts toward your multiple attack penalty, but do not increase your penalty until you have made all your attacks.

offensiveAbilities.name: Viscious Evisceration
offensiveAbilities.description: You make a vicious attack that maims your enemy. Make a melee Strike. If the Strike hits and deals damage, the target is drained 1, or drained 2 on a critical success.

Effect you Sustain a Spell

offensiveAbilities.name: Eternal Composition
offensiveAbilities.description: You are permanently quickened, and can use the extra action only to cast composition cantrips that require 1 action to cast.

generalAbilities.name: Celestial/Fiendish Form
generalAbilities.description: The champion gains a fly speed equal to their speed, as well as darkvision, and the celestial/fiend trait.

defensiveAbilities.name: Retributive Strike
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger An enemy damages your ally, and both are within 15 feet of you.
Effect
  • The ally gains resistance to all damage against the triggering damage equal to 2 + your level.
  • If the foe is within reach, make a melee Strike against it.
  • Each ally within 15 feet of you with the target in their melee reach can spend a reaction to Strike the target with a –5 penalty.
  • The triggering creature takes 5 persistent good or evil damage.

defensiveAbilities.name: Ranged Reprisal
defensiveAbilities.description: The champion can use Retributive Strike with a ranged weapon. If the triggering creature is within 5 feet of the champion's reach, the champion may Step as part of their reaction in order to reach them.

defensiveAbilities.name: Raise Shield
defensiveAbilities.description: The champion gains a +2 circumstance bonus to their AC until the start of their next turn.

This Strike doesn’t count toward your multiple attack penalty, and your multiple attack penalty doesn’t apply to this Strike.

defensiveAbilities.name: Aura of Faith
defensiveAbilities.description: Your strikes deal 1 additional good/evil damage, and each good/evil aligned ally within 15 feet gains this benefit on their first Strike that hits and evil creature each round. (swap this for evil if this champion is evil)

defensiveAbilities.name: Divine Reflexes
defensiveAbilities.description: The champion gains an additional reaction per turn that they can only use for a Retributive Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Greater Mercy
offensiveAbilities.description: If the next action you use is to cast lay on hands, you can attempt to counteract either a fear effect, an effect imposing the paralyzed, blinded, deafened, sickened, or slowed condition, on the target, in addition to the other benefits of lay on hands.

offensiveAbilities.name: Healing/Harming Hands
offensiveAbilities.description: Your Heals/Harms deal d10s instead of d8s

offensiveAbilities.name: Channel Smite
offensiveAbilities.description:
Cost Expend a harm or heal spell
EffectYou siphon the destructive energies of positive or negative energy through a melee attack and into your foe. Make a melee Strike and add the spell’s damage to the Strike’s damage. This is negative damage if you expended a harm spell or positive damage if you expended a heal spell. The spell is expended with no effect if your Strike fails or hits a creature that isn’t damaged by that energy type (such as if you hit a non-undead creature with a heal spell).

offensiveAbilities.name: Selective Energy
offensiveAbilities.description: As you call down divine power, you can prevent some enemies from benefiting or some allies from being hurt. When you cast a version of harm or heal that has an area, you can designate a number of creatures equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1) that are not targeted by the spell.

offensiveAbilities.name: Channeled Succor
offensiveAbilities.description: You can remove conditions with divine grace. You can sacrifice one heal spell you’ve prepared in your extra slots from healing font to cast one of the following spells instead: remove curse, remove disease, remove paralysis, or restoration. The spell is heightened to the same level as the heal spell you sacrificed.

offensiveAbilities.name: Defensive Recovery
offensiveAbilities.description: If the next action you use is to cast harm or heal on a single target and the target regains Hit Points from the spell, it also gains a +2 status bonus to AC and saving throws for 1 round.

offensiveAbilities.name: Fast Channel
offensiveAbilities.description: When you cast harm or heal by spending 2 actions, you can get the effects of the 3-action version instead of the 2-action version.

offensiveAbilities.name: Eternal Blessing/Bane
offensiveAbilities.description: You continuously have Bless or Bane active, the emanation is 15 feet, and you can't increase it.

offensiveAbilities.name: Thousand Faces
offensiveAbilities.description: You add the forms listed in humanoid form to your wild shape list.

offensiveAbilities.name: Insect Shape
offensiveAbilities.description: Add the forms in insect form to your wild shape list. Whenever you use wild shape to polymorph into the non-flying insect form listed in pest form, the duration is 24 hours instead of 10 minutes.

offensiveAbilities.name: Ferocious Shape
offensiveAbilities.description: Add the forms listed in dinosaur form to your wild shape list. Whenever you use wild shape to take a form that grants you a specific Athletics modifier, you gain a +1 status bonus to your Athletics checks.

offensiveAbilities.name: Soaring Shape
offensiveAbilities.description: Add the bat and bird forms in aerial form to your wild shape list. If you have Insect Shape, you also add the wasp form to your wild shape list. If you have Ferocious Shape, you also add the pterosaur form to your wild shape list. Whenever you use wild shape to gain a form that grants you a specific Acrobatics modifier, you gain a +1 status bonus to Acrobatics checks.

offensiveAbilities.name: Dragon Shape
offensiveAbilities.description: Add the forms listed in dragon form to your wild shape list. Whenever you’re polymorphed into another form using wild shape, you gain resistance 5 to your choice of acid, cold, electricity, fire, or poison.

offensiveAbilities.name: Monstrosity Shape
offensiveAbilities.description: Add the purple worm and sea serpent forms listed in monstrosity form to your wild shape list. If you have Soaring Shape, also add the phoenix form to your wild shape list.

Effect you Sustain a Spell

offensiveAbilities.description:
FrequencyOnce per minute
Effect If your next action is to Cast a Spell of 5th level or lower that has no duration, you don’t expend the prepared spell as you cast it.

offensiveAbilities.description: The fighter makes a Strike against all creatures in its melee range. Apply the multiple attack penalties after it's made all strikes.

offensiveAbilities.name: Weapons Supremacy

offensiveAbilities.description: Make two melee strikes. If they hit the same creature, combine their damage for the purpose of resistances and weaknesses.

offensiveAbilities.name: Widen Spell
offensiveAbilities.description: If your next action is to Cast a Spell that has an area of a burst, cone, or line, and does not have a duration; Add 5 feet to the radius of a burst that normally has a radius of at least 10 feet (a burst with a smaller radius is not affected). Add 5 feet to the length of a cone or line that is normally 15 feet long or smaller, and add 10 feet to the length of a larger cone or line.

Frequency Once per day per spell level
Effect Mark one spell that's already been cast as uncast. The wizard can cast it again. The wizard can do this for each level of spell slots they have.

offensiveAbilities.name: Reflect Spell
offensiveAbilities.description: When you succesfully use Counterspell to counteract a spell that affects targeted creatures or an area, you reflect it back on its caster. The spell now only affects the original caster, even if it was an area spell, or one that would affect multiple creatures. The original caster can attempt saves and use other defenses against the spell as normal.

offensiveAbilities.description: You keep your bombs in easy-to-reach pouches from which you draw without thinking. You Interact to draw a bomb, then Strike with it.

offensiveAbilities.description:
FrequencyOnce per round
TriggerYou use Quick Alchemy to craft an alchemical bomb that is at least 2 levels lower than your advanced alchemy level.
EffectYou mix in an additive to make your bomb’s contents adhere to the target and continue to deal damage. A creature that takes a direct hit from one of your sticky bombs also takes persistent damage equal to and of the same type as the bomb’s splash damage. If the bomb already deals persistent damage, combine the two amounts.

offensiveAbilities.name: True Debilitating Bomb
offensiveAbilities.description:
FrequencyOnce per round
TriggerYou use Quick Alchemy to craft an alchemical bomb that is at least 2 levels lower than your advanced alchemy level.
EffectYour bombs impose additional effects on your enemies. You mix a substance into the bomb that causes one of the following: dazzled, deafened, flat-footed, clumsy 1, enfeebled 2, stupefied 2, or a –15-foot status penalty to Speeds. If the attack with that bomb hits, the target must succeed at a Fortitude saving throw or suffer that effect until the start of your next turn. Use your class DC for this saving throw (even if someone else throws the bomb).

offensiveAbilities.name: Miracle Worker
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency Once every 10 minutes
EffectYour alchemical mastery can resuscitate the recently slain. You can administer a true elixir of life to a creature who has been dead for no more than 2 rounds. When you do, that creature is immediately returned to life with 1 Hit Point and becomes wounded 1.

generalAbilities.name: Raging Intimidation
generalAbilities.description: The barbarian can Demoralize while Raging

defensiveAbilities.name: Shake it off
defensiveAbilities.description: You concentrate on your rage, overcoming fear and fighting back sickness. Reduce your frightened condition value by 1, and attempt a Fortitude save to recover from the sickened condition as if you had spent an action retching; you reduce your sickened condition value by 1 on a failure (but not on a critical failure), by 2 on a success, or by 3 on a critical success.

defensiveAbilities.name: Attack of Opportunity
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature within your reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it’s using.

You lash out at a foe that leaves an opening. Make a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If your attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, you disrupt that action. This Strike doesn’t count toward your multiple attack penalty, and your multiple attack penalty doesn’t apply to this Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Rage
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements You aren’t fatigued or raging.

You tap into your inner fury and begin raging. You gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to your level plus your Constitution modifier. This frenzy lasts for 1 minute, until there are no enemies you can perceive, or until you fall unconscious, whichever comes first. You can't voluntarily stop raging. While you are raging:

  • You deal 12 additional damage with melee Strikes. This additional damage is halved if your weapon or unarmed attack is agile.
  • You take a –1 penalty to AC.
  • You can't use actions with the concentrate trait unless they also have the rage trait. You can Seek while raging.

    • After you stop raging, you lose any remaining temporary Hit Points from Rage, and you can't Rage again for 1 minute.

offensiveAbilities.name: Fast Movement
offensiveAbilities.description: Your rage is a frenzy of rapid movements. While you are raging, you gain a +10-foot status bonus to your Speed

offensiveAbilities.name: Knockback
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements Your last action was a successful Strike.

The weight of your swing drives your enemy back. You push the foe back 5 feet, with the effects of a successful Shove. You can follow the foe as normal for a successful Shove.

offensiveAbilities.name: Whirlwind Strike
offensiveAbilities.description: You attack all nearby adversaries. Make a melee Strike against each enemy within your melee reach. Each attack counts toward your multiple attack penalty, but do not increase your penalty until you have made all your attacks.

offensiveAbilities.name: Viscious Evisceration
offensiveAbilities.description: You make a vicious attack that maims your enemy. Make a melee Strike. If the Strike hits and deals damage, the target is drained 1, or drained 2 on a critical success.

offensiveAbilities.name: Quickened Casting
offensiveAbilities.description: If your next action is to cast a cantrip or a spell that is at least 2 levels lower than the highest level spell slot you have, reduce the number of actions to cast it by 1 (minimum 1 action).

Trigger Your turn begins
Effect you Sustain a Spell

offensiveAbilities.name: Eternal Composition
offensiveAbilities.description: You are permanently quickened, and can use the extra action only to cast composition cantrips that require 1 action to cast.

generalAbilities.name: Celestial/Fiendish Form
generalAbilities.description: The champion gains a fly speed equal to their speed, as well as darkvision, and the celestial/fiend trait.

defensiveAbilities.name: Retributive Strike
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger An enemy damages your ally, and both are within 15 feet of you.
Effect
  • The ally gains resistance to all damage against the triggering damage equal to 2 + your level.
  • If the foe is within reach, make a melee Strike against it.
  • Each ally within 15 feet of you with the target in their melee reach can spend a reaction to Strike the target with a –5 penalty.
  • The triggering creature takes 5 persistent good or evil damage.

defensiveAbilities.name: Ranged Reprisal
defensiveAbilities.description: The champion can use Retributive Strike with a ranged weapon. If the triggering creature is within 5 feet of the champion's reach, the champion may Step as part of their reaction in order to reach them.

defensiveAbilities.name: Raise Shield
defensiveAbilities.description: The champion gains a +2 circumstance bonus to their AC until the start of their next turn.

This Strike doesn’t count toward your multiple attack penalty, and your multiple attack penalty doesn’t apply to this Strike.

defensiveAbilities.name: Aura of Faith
defensiveAbilities.description: Your strikes deal 1 additional good/evil damage, and each good/evil aligned ally within 15 feet gains this benefit on their first Strike that hits and evil creature each round. (swap this for evil if this champion is evil)

defensiveAbilities.name: Divine Reflexes
defensiveAbilities.description: The champion gains an additional reaction per turn that they can only use for a Retributive Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Greater Mercy
offensiveAbilities.description: If the next action you use is to cast lay on hands, you can attempt to counteract either a fear effect, an effect imposing the paralyzed, blinded, deafened, sickened, or slowed condition, on the target, in addition to the other benefits of lay on hands.

offensiveAbilities.name: Healing/Harming Hands
offensiveAbilities.description: Your Heals/Harms deal d10s instead of d8s

offensiveAbilities.name: Channel Smite
offensiveAbilities.description:
Cost Expend a harm or heal spell
EffectYou siphon the destructive energies of positive or negative energy through a melee attack and into your foe. Make a melee Strike and add the spell’s damage to the Strike’s damage. This is negative damage if you expended a harm spell or positive damage if you expended a heal spell. The spell is expended with no effect if your Strike fails or hits a creature that isn’t damaged by that energy type (such as if you hit a non-undead creature with a heal spell).

offensiveAbilities.name: Selective Energy
offensiveAbilities.description: As you call down divine power, you can prevent some enemies from benefiting or some allies from being hurt. When you cast a version of harm or heal that has an area, you can designate a number of creatures equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1) that are not targeted by the spell.

offensiveAbilities.name: Channeled Succor
offensiveAbilities.description: You can remove conditions with divine grace. You can sacrifice one heal spell you’ve prepared in your extra slots from healing font to cast one of the following spells instead: remove curse, remove disease, remove paralysis, or restoration. The spell is heightened to the same level as the heal spell you sacrificed.

offensiveAbilities.name: Defensive Recovery
offensiveAbilities.description: If the next action you use is to cast harm or heal on a single target and the target regains Hit Points from the spell, it also gains a +2 status bonus to AC and saving throws for 1 round.

offensiveAbilities.name: Fast Channel
offensiveAbilities.description: When you cast harm or heal by spending 2 actions, you can get the effects of the 3-action version instead of the 2-action version.

offensiveAbilities.name: Eternal Blessing/Bane
offensiveAbilities.description: You continuously have Bless or Bane active, the emanation is 15 feet, and you can't increase it.

offensiveAbilities.name: Thousand Faces
offensiveAbilities.description: You add the forms listed in humanoid form to your wild shape list.

offensiveAbilities.name: Insect Shape
offensiveAbilities.description: Add the forms in insect form to your wild shape list. Whenever you use wild shape to polymorph into the non-flying insect form listed in pest form, the duration is 24 hours instead of 10 minutes.

offensiveAbilities.name: Ferocious Shape
offensiveAbilities.description: Add the forms listed in dinosaur form to your wild shape list. Whenever you use wild shape to take a form that grants you a specific Athletics modifier, you gain a +1 status bonus to your Athletics checks.

offensiveAbilities.name: Soaring Shape
offensiveAbilities.description: Add the bat and bird forms in aerial form to your wild shape list. If you have Insect Shape, you also add the wasp form to your wild shape list. If you have Ferocious Shape, you also add the pterosaur form to your wild shape list. Whenever you use wild shape to gain a form that grants you a specific Acrobatics modifier, you gain a +1 status bonus to Acrobatics checks.

offensiveAbilities.name: Dragon Shape
offensiveAbilities.description: Add the forms listed in dragon form to your wild shape list. Whenever you’re polymorphed into another form using wild shape, you gain resistance 5 to your choice of acid, cold, electricity, fire, or poison.

offensiveAbilities.name: Monstrosity Shape
offensiveAbilities.description: Add the purple worm and sea serpent forms listed in monstrosity form to your wild shape list. If you have Soaring Shape, also add the phoenix form to your wild shape list.

Effect you Sustain a Spell

offensiveAbilities.name: Leyline Conduit
offensiveAbilities.description:
FrequencyOnce per minute
Effect If your next action is to Cast a Spell of 5th level or lower that has no duration, you don’t expend the prepared spell as you cast it.

defensiveAbilities.description: The fighter gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of their next turn.

offensiveAbilities.name: Sudden Charge
offensiveAbilities.description: The Fighter takes two Stride actions, and then a Strike action.

offensiveAbilities.name: Intimidating Strike
offensiveAbilities.description: Make a melee Strike. If you hit and deal damage, the target is frightened 1, or frightened 2 on a critical hit.

offensiveAbilities.name: Knockdown
offensiveAbilities.description: Make a melee Strike. If it hits and deals damage, you can attempt an Athletics check to Trip the creature you hit. Both attacks count toward your multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after you've made both of them.

offensiveAbilities.name: Whirlwind Strike
offensiveAbilities.description: The fighter makes a Strike against all creatures in its melee range. Apply the multiple attack penalties after it's made all strikes.

offensiveAbilities.name: Weapons Supremacy
offensiveAbilities.description: The fighter is permanently quickened 1, and can use the extra action only to Strike.

defensiveAbilities.name: Deflect Arrow
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The monk is the target of a physical ranged attack.
Requirements The monk is aware of the attack, and is not flat-footed against it.
You gain a +4 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack. If the attack misses, you have deflected it. You cannot use this feat to deflect unusually massive ranged projectiles (such as boulders or ballista bolts).

offensiveAbilities.name: Flurry of Blows
offensiveAbilities.description: Make two melee strikes. If they hit the same creature, combine their damage for the purpose of resistances and weaknesses.

offensiveAbilities.name: Mystic/Metal Strikes
offensiveAbilities.description: The Monk's unarmed strikes count as magical, and as silver and cold iron.

offensiveAbilities.name: Perfected Form
offensiveAbilities.description: For their first Strike, the monk can't roll below a 10 on the die.

offensiveAbilities.name: Wolf Stance
offensiveAbilities.description: The monk enters wolf stance, allowing them to use the wolf jaw strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Crushing Grab
offensiveAbilities.description: When the monk successfully Grapples a creature, they can deal 4 bludgeoning damage to that creature.

offensiveAbilities.name: Wolf Drag
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements You are in Wolf Stance.
You rip your enemy off their feet. Make a wolf jaw Strike. Your wolf jaw gains the fatal d12 trait for this Strike, and if the attack succeeds, you knock the target prone.

offensiveAbilities.name: Wall Run
offensiveAbilities.description: The monk Strides up to their Speed. They must start your movement on a horizontal surface. During this movement, they can run up vertical surfaces, like walls, at their full Speed. If they end the Stride off the ground, they fall after taking their next action or when your turn ends, whichever comes first (though you can Grab an Edge, if applicable).

offensiveAbilities.name: Winding Flow
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per round
You use two of the following actions in any order: Stand, Step, and Stride. You can’t use the same action twice.

offensiveAbilities.name: Shattering Strike
offensiveAbilities.description: The force of your considered blow shatters objects and defenses alike. Make an unarmed Strike. It bypasses the target’s resistances. If the target has Hardness, the Strike treats the Hardness as if it were half its value.

offensiveAbilities.name: Enduring Quickness
offensiveAbilities.description: You move as fast and as high as the wind itself. You’re permanently quickened. You can use your extra action to Stride or Leap, or to provide one of the actions needed for a High Jump or Long Jump.

offensiveAbilities.name: Hunt Prey
offensiveAbilities.description: Designate a target as prey, you gain a +4 circumstance bonus Seek and Track them, and ignore penalty for making ranged attacks within your second and third range increment against the prey you’re hunting. You can only have 1 creature marked as prey.<hr>You can use this as a free action if it's the first action on your turn.

offensiveAbilities.name: Precision Edge
offensiveAbilities.description: The first time they hit their Prey this turn, the Ranger deals an extra 3d8 precision damage to them; 2d8 precision damage the second time; and 1d8 precision damage the third time.

offensiveAbilities.name: Nature's Edge
offensiveAbilities.description: Enemies in naturally occuring difficult terrain are flat-footed to the Ranger.

offensiveAbilities.name: Quickdraw
offensiveAbilities.description: The Ranger draws a weapon and makes a Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Skirmish Strike
offensiveAbilities.description: The Ranger Steps and then Strikes, or Strikes and then Steps

offensiveAbilities.name: Blind Fight
offensiveAbilities.description: The Ranger does not need to make flat checks to hit concealed creatures, and the flat check to hit hidden creatures is only DC 5. They are not Flat-Footed to Hidden creatures because of their Hidden status.

offensiveAbilities.name: Camouflage
offensiveAbilities.description: The Ranger can Sneak in natural terrain, even if Observed.

offensiveAbilities.name: Shadow Hunter
offensiveAbilities.description: In natural terrain, he Ranger is always concealed, except to its Prey.

offensiveAbilities.name: Ultimate Skirmisher
offensiveAbilities.description: The ranger does not trigger Hazards, and ignores Difficult Terrain, Greater Difficult Terrain, and Hazardous Terrain.

generalAbilities.name: Sneak Savant
generalAbilities.description: If the rogue fails a Stealth check, they gets a success instead. They can still critically fail.

defensiveAbilities.name: Nimble Dodge
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The rogue is targeted with an attack, and can see the attacker.
EffectThe rogue gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the attack.

defensiveAbilities.name: Mobility
defensiveAbilities.description: If the rogue strides half their movement, it does not trigger reactions.

offensiveAbilities.name: Sneak Attack
offensiveAbilities.description: The Rogue deals an extra 6d6 precision damage to flat-footed creatures.

offensiveAbilities.name: Surprise attack
offensiveAbilities.description: Creatures that haven't taken a turn yet are flat-footed to the rogue

offensiveAbilities.name: Gang Up
offensiveAbilities.description: Enemies within reach of allies count as flat-footed to the rogue, regardless of the ally's position.

offensiveAbilities.name: Opportune Backstab
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature within the rogue's melee reach is hit by a melee attack from one of its allies.
Effect The rogue makes a strike against the creature.

offensiveAbilities.name: Spring from the Shadows
offensiveAbilities.description: The rogue strides up to a creature it is hidden or undetected by, and strikes. The rogue stays hidden or undetected until after the strike.

generalAbilities.description: The barbarian can Demoralize while Raging

defensiveAbilities.name: Shake it off
defensiveAbilities.description: You concentrate on your rage, overcoming fear and fighting back sickness. Reduce your frightened condition value by 1, and attempt a Fortitude save to recover from the sickened condition as if you had spent an action retching; you reduce your sickened condition value by 1 on a failure (but not on a critical failure), by 2 on a success, or by 3 on a critical success.

defensiveAbilities.name: Attack of Opportunity
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature within your reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it’s using.

You lash out at a foe that leaves an opening. Make a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If your attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, you disrupt that action. This Strike doesn’t count toward your multiple attack penalty, and your multiple attack penalty doesn’t apply to this Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Rage
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements You aren’t fatigued or raging.

You tap into your inner fury and begin raging. You gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to your level plus your Constitution modifier. This frenzy lasts for 1 minute, until there are no enemies you can perceive, or until you fall unconscious, whichever comes first. You can't voluntarily stop raging. While you are raging:

  • You deal 12 additional damage with melee Strikes. This additional damage is halved if your weapon or unarmed attack is agile.
  • You take a –1 penalty to AC.
  • You can't use actions with the concentrate trait unless they also have the rage trait. You can Seek while raging.

    • After you stop raging, you lose any remaining temporary Hit Points from Rage, and you can't Rage again for 1 minute.

offensiveAbilities.name: Fast Movement
offensiveAbilities.description: Your rage is a frenzy of rapid movements. While you are raging, you gain a +10-foot status bonus to your Speed

offensiveAbilities.name: Knockback
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements Your last action was a successful Strike.

The weight of your swing drives your enemy back. You push the foe back 5 feet, with the effects of a successful Shove. You can follow the foe as normal for a successful Shove.

offensiveAbilities.name: Whirlwind Strike
offensiveAbilities.description: You attack all nearby adversaries. Make a melee Strike against each enemy within your melee reach. Each attack counts toward your multiple attack penalty, but do not increase your penalty until you have made all your attacks.

offensiveAbilities.name: Viscious Evisceration
offensiveAbilities.description: You make a vicious attack that maims your enemy. Make a melee Strike. If the Strike hits and deals damage, the target is drained 1, or drained 2 on a critical success.

offensiveAbilities.name: Quickened Casting
offensiveAbilities.description: If your next action is to cast a cantrip or a spell that is at least 2 levels lower than the highest level spell slot you have, reduce the number of actions to cast it by 1 (minimum 1 action).

offensiveAbilities.name: Reach Spell
offensiveAbilities.description: If your next action is to Cast a Spell that has a range, increase that spell's range by 30ft

offensiveAbilities.name: Effortless Concentration
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger Your turn begins
Effect you Sustain a Spell

offensiveAbilities.name: Eternal Composition
offensiveAbilities.description: You are permanently quickened, and can use the extra action only to cast composition cantrips that require 1 action to cast.

generalAbilities.name: Celestial/Fiendish Form
generalAbilities.description: The champion gains a fly speed equal to their speed, as well as darkvision, and the celestial/fiend trait.

defensiveAbilities.name: Retributive Strike
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger An enemy damages your ally, and both are within 15 feet of you.
Effect
  • The ally gains resistance to all damage against the triggering damage equal to 2 + your level.
  • If the foe is within reach, make a melee Strike against it.
  • Each ally within 15 feet of you with the target in their melee reach can spend a reaction to Strike the target with a –5 penalty.
  • The triggering creature takes 5 persistent good or evil damage.

defensiveAbilities.name: Ranged Reprisal
defensiveAbilities.description: The champion can use Retributive Strike with a ranged weapon. If the triggering creature is within 5 feet of the champion's reach, the champion may Step as part of their reaction in order to reach them.

defensiveAbilities.name: Raise Shield
defensiveAbilities.description: The champion gains a +2 circumstance bonus to their AC until the start of their next turn.

You lash out at a foe that leaves an opening. Make a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If your attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, you disrupt that action. This Strike doesn’t count toward your multiple attack penalty, and your multiple attack penalty doesn’t apply to this Strike.

defensiveAbilities.name: Aura of Faith
defensiveAbilities.description: Your strikes deal 1 additional good/evil damage, and each good/evil aligned ally within 15 feet gains this benefit on their first Strike that hits and evil creature each round. (swap this for evil if this champion is evil)

defensiveAbilities.name: Divine Reflexes
defensiveAbilities.description: The champion gains an additional reaction per turn that they can only use for a Retributive Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Greater Mercy
offensiveAbilities.description: If the next action you use is to cast lay on hands, you can attempt to counteract either a fear effect, an effect imposing the paralyzed, blinded, deafened, sickened, or slowed condition, on the target, in addition to the other benefits of lay on hands.

offensiveAbilities.name: Healing/Harming Hands
offensiveAbilities.description: Your Heals/Harms deal d10s instead of d8s

offensiveAbilities.name: Channel Smite
offensiveAbilities.description:
Cost Expend a harm or heal spell
EffectYou siphon the destructive energies of positive or negative energy through a melee attack and into your foe. Make a melee Strike and add the spell’s damage to the Strike’s damage. This is negative damage if you expended a harm spell or positive damage if you expended a heal spell. The spell is expended with no effect if your Strike fails or hits a creature that isn’t damaged by that energy type (such as if you hit a non-undead creature with a heal spell).

offensiveAbilities.name: Selective Energy
offensiveAbilities.description: As you call down divine power, you can prevent some enemies from benefiting or some allies from being hurt. When you cast a version of harm or heal that has an area, you can designate a number of creatures equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1) that are not targeted by the spell.

offensiveAbilities.name: Channeled Succor
offensiveAbilities.description: You can remove conditions with divine grace. You can sacrifice one heal spell you’ve prepared in your extra slots from healing font to cast one of the following spells instead: remove curse, remove disease, remove paralysis, or restoration. The spell is heightened to the same level as the heal spell you sacrificed.

offensiveAbilities.name: Defensive Recovery
offensiveAbilities.description: If the next action you use is to cast harm or heal on a single target and the target regains Hit Points from the spell, it also gains a +2 status bonus to AC and saving throws for 1 round.

offensiveAbilities.name: Fast Channel
offensiveAbilities.description: When you cast harm or heal by spending 2 actions, you can get the effects of the 3-action version instead of the 2-action version.

offensiveAbilities.name: Eternal Blessing/Bane
offensiveAbilities.description: You continuously have Bless or Bane active, the emanation is 15 feet, and you can't increase it.

offensiveAbilities.name: Raise Shield
offensiveAbilities.description: You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn.

defensiveAbilities.description: you gain a +2 circumstance bonus until the start of your next turn.

offensiveAbilities.name: Thousand Faces
offensiveAbilities.description: You add the forms listed in humanoid form to your wild shape list.

offensiveAbilities.name: Insect Shape
offensiveAbilities.description: Add the forms in insect form to your wild shape list. Whenever you use wild shape to polymorph into the non-flying insect form listed in pest form, the duration is 24 hours instead of 10 minutes.

offensiveAbilities.name: Ferocious Shape
offensiveAbilities.description: Add the forms listed in dinosaur form to your wild shape list. Whenever you use wild shape to take a form that grants you a specific Athletics modifier, you gain a +1 status bonus to your Athletics checks.

offensiveAbilities.name: Soaring Shape
offensiveAbilities.description: Add the bat and bird forms in aerial form to your wild shape list. If you have Insect Shape, you also add the wasp form to your wild shape list. If you have Ferocious Shape, you also add the pterosaur form to your wild shape list. Whenever you use wild shape to gain a form that grants you a specific Acrobatics modifier, you gain a +1 status bonus to Acrobatics checks.

offensiveAbilities.name: Dragon Shape
offensiveAbilities.description: Add the forms listed in dragon form to your wild shape list. Whenever you’re polymorphed into another form using wild shape, you gain resistance 5 to your choice of acid, cold, electricity, fire, or poison.

offensiveAbilities.name: Monstrosity Shape
offensiveAbilities.description: Add the purple worm and sea serpent forms listed in monstrosity form to your wild shape list. If you have Soaring Shape, also add the phoenix form to your wild shape list.

offensiveAbilities.name: Effortless Concentration
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger Your turn begins
Effect you Sustain a Spell

offensiveAbilities.name: Leyline Conduit
offensiveAbilities.description:
FrequencyOnce per minute
Effect If your next action is to Cast a Spell of 5th level or lower that has no duration, you don’t expend the prepared spell as you cast it.

defensiveAbilities.name: Raise Shield
defensiveAbilities.description: The fighter gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of their next turn.

This Strike doesn’t count toward your multiple attack penalty, and your multiple attack penalty doesn’t apply to this Strike.

defensiveAbilities.name: Combat Reflexes
defensiveAbilities.description: The fighter has an additional reaction per turn, exclusively for Attacks of Opportunity

offensiveAbilities.name: Sudden Charge
offensiveAbilities.description: The Fighter takes two Stride actions, and then a Strike action.

offensiveAbilities.name: Intimidating Strike
offensiveAbilities.description: Make a melee Strike. If you hit and deal damage, the target is frightened 1, or frightened 2 on a critical hit.

offensiveAbilities.name: Knockdown
offensiveAbilities.description: Make a melee Strike. If it hits and deals damage, you can attempt an Athletics check to Trip the creature you hit. Both attacks count toward your multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after you've made both of them.

offensiveAbilities.name: Whirlwind Strike
offensiveAbilities.description: The fighter makes a Strike against all creatures in its melee range. Apply the multiple attack penalties after it's made all strikes.

offensiveAbilities.name: Weapons Supremacy
offensiveAbilities.description: The fighter is permanently quickened 1, and can use the extra action only to Strike.

defensiveAbilities.name: Deflect Arrow
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The monk is the target of a physical ranged attack.
Requirements The monk is aware of the attack, and is not flat-footed against it.
You gain a +4 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack. If the attack misses, you have deflected it. You cannot use this feat to deflect unusually massive ranged projectiles (such as boulders or ballista bolts).

offensiveAbilities.name: Flurry of Blows
offensiveAbilities.description: Make two melee strikes. If they hit the same creature, combine their damage for the purpose of resistances and weaknesses.

offensiveAbilities.name: Mystic/Metal Strikes
offensiveAbilities.description: The Monk's unarmed strikes count as magical, and as silver and cold iron.

offensiveAbilities.name: Perfected Form
offensiveAbilities.description: For their first Strike, the monk can't roll below a 10 on the die.

offensiveAbilities.name: Wolf Stance
offensiveAbilities.description: The monk enters wolf stance, allowing them to use the wolf jaw strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Crushing Grab
offensiveAbilities.description: When the monk successfully Grapples a creature, they can deal 4 bludgeoning damage to that creature.

offensiveAbilities.name: Wolf Drag
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements You are in Wolf Stance.
You rip your enemy off their feet. Make a wolf jaw Strike. Your wolf jaw gains the fatal d12 trait for this Strike, and if the attack succeeds, you knock the target prone.

offensiveAbilities.name: Wall Run
offensiveAbilities.description: The monk Strides up to their Speed. They must start your movement on a horizontal surface. During this movement, they can run up vertical surfaces, like walls, at their full Speed. If they end the Stride off the ground, they fall after taking their next action or when your turn ends, whichever comes first (though you can Grab an Edge, if applicable).

offensiveAbilities.name: Winding Flow
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per round
You use two of the following actions in any order: Stand, Step, and Stride. You can’t use the same action twice.

offensiveAbilities.name: Shattering Strike
offensiveAbilities.description: The force of your considered blow shatters objects and defenses alike. Make an unarmed Strike. It bypasses the target’s resistances. If the target has Hardness, the Strike treats the Hardness as if it were half its value.

offensiveAbilities.name: Enduring Quickness
offensiveAbilities.description: You move as fast and as high as the wind itself. You’re permanently quickened. You can use your extra action to Stride or Leap, or to provide one of the actions needed for a High Jump or Long Jump.

offensiveAbilities.name: Hunt Prey
offensiveAbilities.description: Designate a target as prey, you gain a +4 circumstance bonus Seek and Track them, and ignore penalty for making ranged attacks within your second and third range increment against the prey you’re hunting. You can only have 1 creature marked as prey.<hr>You can use this as a free action if it's the first action on your turn.

offensiveAbilities.name: Precision Edge
offensiveAbilities.description: The first time they hit their Prey this turn, the Ranger deals an extra 3d8 precision damage to them; 2d8 precision damage the second time; and 1d8 precision damage the third time.

offensiveAbilities.name: Nature's Edge
offensiveAbilities.description: Enemies in naturally occuring difficult terrain are flat-footed to the Ranger.

offensiveAbilities.name: Quickdraw
offensiveAbilities.description: The Ranger draws a weapon and makes a Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Skirmish Strike
offensiveAbilities.description: The Ranger Steps and then Strikes, or Strikes and then Steps

offensiveAbilities.name: Blind Fight
offensiveAbilities.description: The Ranger does not need to make flat checks to hit concealed creatures, and the flat check to hit hidden creatures is only DC 5. They are not Flat-Footed to Hidden creatures because of their Hidden status.

offensiveAbilities.name: Camouflage
offensiveAbilities.description: The Ranger can Sneak in natural terrain, even if Observed.

offensiveAbilities.name: Shadow Hunter
offensiveAbilities.description: In natural terrain, he Ranger is always concealed, except to its Prey.

offensiveAbilities.name: Ultimate Skirmisher
offensiveAbilities.description: The ranger does not trigger Hazards, and ignores Difficult Terrain, Greater Difficult Terrain, and Hazardous Terrain.

generalAbilities.name: Sneak Savant
generalAbilities.description: If the rogue fails a Stealth check, they gets a success instead. They can still critically fail.

defensiveAbilities.name: Nimble Dodge
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The rogue is targeted with an attack, and can see the attacker.
EffectThe rogue gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the attack.

defensiveAbilities.name: Mobility
defensiveAbilities.description: If the rogue strides half their movement, it does not trigger reactions.

offensiveAbilities.name: Sneak Attack
offensiveAbilities.description: The Rogue deals an extra 6d6 precision damage to flat-footed creatures.

offensiveAbilities.name: Surprise attack
offensiveAbilities.description: Creatures that haven't taken a turn yet are flat-footed to the rogue

offensiveAbilities.name: Gang Up
offensiveAbilities.description: Enemies within reach of allies count as flat-footed to the rogue, regardless of the ally's position.

offensiveAbilities.name: Opportune Backstab
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature within the rogue's melee reach is hit by a melee attack from one of its allies.
Effect The rogue makes a strike against the creature.

offensiveAbilities.name: Spring from the Shadows
offensiveAbilities.description: The rogue strides up to a creature it is hidden or undetected by, and strikes. The rogue stays hidden or undetected until after the strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Dangerous Sorcery
offensiveAbilities.description: When you cast a spell from your spell slots, if the spell deals damage and doesn't have a duration, you gain a status bonus equal to the spell's level.

offensiveAbilities.name: Quickened Casting
offensiveAbilities.description: If your next action is to cast a cantrip or a spell that is at least 2 levels lower than the highest level spell slot you have, reduce the number of actions to cast it by 1 (minimum 1 action).

offensiveAbilities.name: Widen Spell
offensiveAbilities.description: If your next action is to Cast a Spell that has an area of a burst, cone, or line, and does not have a duration; Add 5 feet to the radius of a burst that normally has a radius of at least 10 feet (a burst with a smaller radius is not affected). Add 5 feet to the length of a cone or line that is normally 15 feet long or smaller, and add 10 feet to the length of a larger cone or line.

defensiveAbilities.name: Counterspell
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature Casts a Spell that the Wizard has prepared.
Effect Expend a spells slot of the same spell. Then counteract the same spell. You lose the spell slot if it was not the same spell.

offensiveAbilities.name: Drain Bonded Item (Universalist)
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency Once per day per spell level
Effect Mark one spell that's already been cast as uncast. The wizard can cast it again. The wizard can do this for each level of spell slots they have.

offensiveAbilities.name: Reflect Spell
offensiveAbilities.description: When you succesfully use Counterspell to counteract a spell that affects targeted creatures or an area, you reflect it back on its caster. The spell now only affects the original caster, even if it was an area spell, or one that would affect multiple creatures. The original caster can attempt saves and use other defenses against the spell as normal.
